summary: Carvana Co. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a $1.66 billion senior secured Term Loan B credit agreement with Barclays Bank PLC as administrative agent. Proceeds will redeem all outstanding 9.0%/11.0%/13.0% Cash/PIK Senior Secured Notes due 2030 in two tranches on August 15 and August 22, 2026, pay fees, and fund general corporate purposes. The facility matures August 14, 2033, with SOFR-plus-2.25% or base-rate-plus-1.25% interest, 0.25% quarterly amortization, and a 1.00% prepayment premium under certain conditions. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation; watch for redemption completion and any early prepayment activity.
